description: Raw HTML email bodies unescaped in DOM, exposing XSS injection vectors; resolved via Bleach 6.1 allowlist sanitization.
Missing OWASP security headers on API responses; resolved by injecting CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options: DENY, and X-Content-Type-Options.
Unrestricted file upload extensions on /api/v1/emails/upload; resolved by enforcing RFC 5322 MIME type and extension allowlist.
Adversarial evasion bypasses (zero-width spaces, Cyrillic homoglyphs, RTLO); resolved via Unicode normalization and homoglyph mapping.
Lack of standardized telemetry exposition; resolved by implementing Prometheus /metrics RED exporter.
Absence of subsystem-level deep health diagnostics; resolved by creating /health/deep database, vault, and ML probes.
Missing automated continuous integration pipeline; resolved by implementing GitHub Actions matrix workflows.
WebSocket verification matched Vite HMR dev socket instead of real dashboard stream; resolved by filtering strictly for /api/v1/dashboard/live.
Data layer ambiguity between Redis/Celery/Neo4j and standalone appliance; resolved by verifying 100% in-process async pipeline with zero Redis/Celery calls during cold boot.
Composite score arithmetic discrepancy; resolved by normalizing weights to strictly 1.000 (100%), yielding exactly 98.0% Base and 97.5% Adjusted.
Full battery stability proof at HEAD; verified across consecutive runs iter_2 and iter_3 on frozen repository.
Demo script JSON-on-projector beat; replaced by visual confusion matrix narrative and feature importance taxonomy.
Hardcoded default secret keys in repo; resolved by adding ENVIRONMENT validator that enforces dynamic injection in production.

evidence: tools/_discriminator.py — modal=0 against [role=dialog],dialog,.modal,[data-modal]; confirmed via EmailDetailModal.tsx
description: EmailDetailModal lacked role='dialog', aria-modal='true', and initial focus. Resolved via 54057fc: added role='dialog' aria-modal='true' aria-label={subject} tabIndex={-1} to overlay div; modalRef.current?.focus() on mount. Verified via golden harness (15/15 PASS).

Remaining focus management after UX-003 ARIA fix: (1) focus trap — Tab and Shift+Tab cycle within the modal focusable elements; (2) focus restoration — when modal closes/unmounts, focus returns to the previously active element. Delivers full WCAG 2.1 SC 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order) compliance.

Mutation testing revealed unit test assertion gaps on earliest hop index selection (M2) and seed idempotency duplicate check (M5); resolved by adding test_earliest_reliable_hop_selection_multi_hop and test_seed_endpoint_idempotency, raising mutant kill rate to 5/5.
Frontend dev server dependency Vite bumped to ^6.4.3 in package.json to address GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99.
Added aria-describedby and screen-reader helper text element to IngestionDropzone.tsx for assistive technology compliance.
Campaign Network Graph canvas text search/filter input to highlight specific entity nodes directly; logged as feature request from 90-score persona.

evidence: tools/verify_sentry.py (golden gates 16 & 17: ui.ingest_upload_e2e, ui.ingest_paste_e2e); unit tests protect endpoint behavior only
description: Browser UI .eml upload and raw RFC 5322 paste fail with 'Failed to fetch' due to missing Vite server.proxy and static API_BASE hostname resolution asymmetry.
Relay hop timestamp subtraction raised TypeError on mixed offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes; resolved via timezone normalization in header_forensics.py.

Feature extraction crashed with AttributeError on None sub-dicts (authentication, earliest_reliable_hop, domain_intel); resolved via null coalesce guards across feature_extractor.py and classifier.py.

Short acronym brands (e.g., 2-3 char strings like 'sbi', 'ibm') triggered false positive lookalike matches on unrelated domains (e.g. 'sub', 'biz'); resolved by bounding relative edit distance (dist/max_len <= 0.35) and minimum brand length >= 4.

General ingest endpoints (/upload and /raw) lacked SHA-256 / multi-vector deduplication, causing duplicate database records and non-idempotent test harness runs; resolved via shared find_existing_email_record helper.

General forensic ingestion (upload/raw) used multi-vector dedupe (Message-ID / Subject+Sender), causing evidence suppression and campaign collapse on distinct byte payloads; resolved by enforcing SHA-256 byte identity ONLY.

evidence: tools/verify_sentry.py (golden gates 16 & 17 probe assertion and feed row count deltas)
description: Gates 16 and 17 in the verification harness checked pre-existing seed subjects, which allowed vacuous passes without verifying live write-path ingestion; resolved by using unique probe fixtures and strictly asserting feed row count increments (+1, +2).

regression_test: tools/verify_sentry.py (scratch DB isolation and Vite proxy mutation kill)
description: The prior mutation-kill receipt showed 39 items due to persistent database pollution in backend/sentry.db and cross-origin fallback resolution; resolved via isolated scratch database (harness_scratch.db), relative API paths, and documented in ERRATA.md.

getApiBase in api.ts previously constructed explicit port 8000 URLs when VITE_API_URL was absent, bypassing Vite's server.proxy and breaking cross-origin deployments; resolved by defaulting to relative URLs ('') so all /api requests route through Vite dev proxy or same-origin reverse proxy.
Red-team evaluation battery lacks a dedicated forged-header-dedupe-suppression attack scenario in the adversarial corpus; documented in adversarial corpus gap tracking.
Single-file upload endpoint rejected extensionless files, ZIP archives, and CSV datasets due to hardcoded extension allowlists in frontend and backend; bulk dropzone was single-file only.
Live threat feed lacked pagination controls (client/server page switching) causing display truncation at default backend limit 50 when viewing large corpora.
Campaign network graph rendered uncapped nodes on 2D canvas force layout, threatening tab freeze on multi-thousand email corpora; requires 300 node rendering cap with user notice.

CSV formula sanitization was incorrectly applied at import time in CSVSynthesizerService, modifying raw evidence bytes; resolved by removing import sanitization to preserve byte fidelity and enforcing OWASP formula neutralization on CSV export writers at write-time.
Missing complete 19-gate verification pair, full mutation outputs, browser at-scale Playwright receipts on 6,777 items, and independent duplicate decomposition receipt.
Multi-message concatenated mbox archives currently parsed as single-message streams rather than discrete multi-record entities; interim behavior documented and single-message mbox supported.
